036        public static void addSevenSonsIntelIfNeeded(String id, TextPanelAPI text) {
037                addSevenSonsIntelIfNeeded(getEntity(id), text);
038        }
039        public static void addSevenSonsIntelIfNeeded(SectorEntityToken entity, TextPanelAPI text) {
040                addSevenSonsIntelIfNeeded(entity, text, false);
041        }
042        public static void addSevenSonsIntelIfNeeded(SectorEntityToken entity, TextPanelAPI text, boolean quiet) {
043                if (getSevenSonsIntel(entity) == null) {
044                        SevenSonsIntel intel = new SevenSonsIntel(entity);
045                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(intel, quiet, text);
046                }
047        }
048        
049        public static void setVisited(SectorEntityToken entity, TextPanelAPI text) {
050                if (isVisited(entity)) return;
051                
052                entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(VISITED, true);
053                if (text != null) {
054                        SevenSonsIntel intel = getSevenSonsIntel(entity);
055                        if (intel != null) {
056                                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntelToTextPanel(intel, text);
057                        }
058                }
059        }
060        
061        public static boolean isVisited(SectorEntityToken entity) {
062                return entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(VISITED) ||
063                                (entity.getMarket() != null && 
064                                entity.getMarket().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(VISITED));
065        }
066        
067        
068        public static SevenSonsIntel getSevenSonsIntel(SectorEntityToken entity) {
069                for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(SevenSonsIntel.class)) {
070                        if (((SevenSonsIntel)intel).getEntity() == entity) return (SevenSonsIntel)intel;
071                }
072                return null;
073        }
074        
075        public static SectorEntityToken getEntity(String id) {
076                MarketAPI market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(id);
077                if (market != null) {
078                        if (market.getPlanetEntity() != null) {
079                                return market.getPlanetEntity();
080                        }
081                        return market.getPrimaryEntity();
082                } else {
083                        return Global.getSector().getEntityById(id);
084                }
085        }

093        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
094                
095                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
096                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
097                float pad = 3f;
098                float opad = 10f;
099                
100                float initPad = pad;
101                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
102                
103                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
104                
105                bullet(info);
106                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
107                
108//              if (mode == ListInfoMode.INTEL) {
109//                      info.addPara("Located in the " + gate.getContainingLocation().getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort(), tc, initPad);
110//                      initPad = 0f;
111//              }
112                
113                boolean visited = isVisited(entity);
114                
115                if (visited) {
116                        Color c = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DIKTAT).getBaseUIColor();
117                        info.addPara("Visited", c, initPad);
118                        initPad = 0f;
119                } else {
120                        info.addPara("Not Visited", tc, initPad);
121                        initPad = 0f;
122                }
123                
124                if (mode == ListInfoMode.INTEL) {
125                        // not sure if this is needed
126                        //info.addPara("In the " + entity.getContainingLocation().getNameWithLowercaseType(), tc, 0f);
127                }
128                
129                unindent(info);
130        }

133        @Override
134        public void createIntelInfo(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
135                String pre = "";
136                String post = "";
137                if (mode == ListInfoMode.MESSAGES) {
138                        pre = "Discovered: ";
139                }
140                if (mode == ListInfoMode.INTEL) {
141                        //post = " - " + entity.getContainingLocation().getNameWithTypeShort();
142                }
143                
144                Color c = getTitleColor(mode);
145                info.addPara(pre + getName() + post, c, 0f);
146                addBulletPoints(info, mode);
147        }

478        public void buttonPressConfirmed(Object buttonId, IntelUIAPI ui) {
479                if (buttonId == BUTTON_SHOW_SEVEN_SONS) {
480                        toggleSonsList(this, ui);
481                        return;
482                }
483                else if (buttonId == BUTTON_SONS_INTEL_DIALOG) {
484                        // launch dialog here.
485                        RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl plugin = new RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl("SevenSonsAndradaFileBegin");
486                        
487                        ui.showDialog(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(), "SevenSonsAndradaFileBegin");
488                        
489                        /*Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().showInteractionDialogFromCargo(plugin, 
490                                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(), new DismissDialogDelegate() {
491                                        @Override
492                                        public void dialogDismissed() {
493                                        }
494                                });*/
495                        return;
496                }
497                else if (buttonId == BUTTON_SONS_INTEL_DIALOG) {
498                        RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl plugin = new RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl("SevenSonsAndradaDecryptBegin");
499                        ui.showDialog(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(), "SevenSonsAndradaDecryptBegin");
500                }
501                super.buttonPressConfirmed(buttonId, ui);
502        }

504        public static void addShowSevenSonsButton(IntelInfoPlugin curr, float width, float height, TooltipMakerAPI info) {
505                if (!Global.getSector().getIntelManager().hasIntelOfClass(SDSevenSons.class)) return;
506

508                                curr instanceof SevenSonsIntel) {

511

519                button.setShortcut(Keyboard.KEY_T, true);

522        public static void toggleSonsList(IntelInfoPlugin curr, IntelUIAPI ui) {
523                if (ui.isShowingCustomIntelSubset()) {
524                        ui.updateIntelList(true);
525                        ui.updateUIForItem(curr);
526                        //for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(LuddicShrineIntel.class)) {
527                        for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(SevenSonsIntel.class)) {
528                                ui.selectItem(intel);
529                                break;
530                        }
531                } else {
532                        List<IntelInfoPlugin> show = new ArrayList<IntelInfoPlugin>();
533                        for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(SevenSonsIntel.class)) {
534                                show.add(intel);
535                        }
536                        //for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(SevenSonsIntel.class)) {
537                        //      show.add(intel);
538                        //}
539                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().sortIntel(show);
540                        ui.updateIntelList(true, show);
541                        ui.updateUIForItem(curr);
542                }
